title: Moment of Decision
next_chapter_hook: In the instant the light from the fourth page faded, Chen Ji sensed a familiar aura emanating from within—a fluctuation unique to his missing sister, Chen Nian.

text.content: The night was as dark as ink. Within the forbidden grounds of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, an almost translucent figure sat cross-legged. Chen Ji's spiritual energy fluctuation was negligible—if one weren't actively probing, there would be no indication anyone existed here. He had maintained this death-feigning state for three full days, all for this moment—to sense the fourth page of the Tianji Record.

The Tianji Record floated before him, its yellowed pages appearing particularly eerie under the moonlight. He had completely absorbed the information from the first three pages, each one deepening his understanding of Heavenly Dao. Yet the fourth page remained shrouded in mist—no matter how he attempted to draw it forth, its contents remained hidden from view.

dialogue.content: "Are you certain you wish to proceed?" Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted from the first page, carrying a cautionary tone. "The fourth page differs from its predecessors—it chronicles the fundamental principles governing Heavenly Dao's mechanics. Once activated, you'll confront the true nature of destiny."

text.content: Chen Ji offered no response. Slowly closing his eyes, he gathered all his divine consciousness into an invisible, delicate needle, gently piercing the barrier of the fourth page. In an instant, a vast tide of information surged into his Mental Sea, threatening to tear his very awareness asunder.

Pain. An indescribable agony spread from the depths of his soul. Chen Ji felt as though he were being fed into an enormous grinding stone, slowly crushed, reorganized, then crushed again. Yet amid this torment, he witnessed—the fourth page of the Tianji Record revealed its complete core information.

"Inheritance Activation Conditions: Confront the core of an unavoidable death sentence, utilize the power of a Destiny Scribe to rewrite one's own fate. Cost: Each use of the Tianji Record reduces lifespan by three years. The day Heavenly Fate Value reaches zero is the moment of soul dispersal." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—was this not precisely what he had been doing all along?

dialogue.content: "Foolish chess piece..." A bone-chilling voice suddenly exploded within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, like frigid wind from the Nine Netherworlds sweeping past. "Do you believe you control the Tianji Record? You are merely another discarded piece I have set in motion." The voice carried an aloof indifference, as if observing a dying ant's final struggles.

text.content: Chen Ji was greatly alarmed. The voice's pressure far exceeded any expert he had ever encountered—even the old Sect Master Ling Yuan would be nothing but dust before this presence. Was this the Eye of Heavenly Dao? That ultimate antagonist? He forcefully suppressed his mounting fear and continued probing deeper into the fourth page, only to discover more information awaiting him.

"To complete the fourth page's full inheritance, the following conditions must be met: First, collect seven Heavenly Fate Fragments scattered across the mortal realm. Second, use Heavenly Fate Value as a medium to construct a human-divine conduit. Third, endure nine rounds of Heavenly Tribulation Lightning. If successful, one may briefly rewrite Heavenly Dao's laws. If failed, both spirit and soul shall perish, forever barred from reincarnation."

Chen Ji drew a sharp breath. This cost was not merely severe—it demanded he gamble his very life. Collecting seven Heavenly Fate Fragments meant becoming an enemy of all experts in the cultivation world. Constructing a human-divine conduit required consuming his entire Heavenly Fate Value reserves. As for nine rounds of Heavenly Tribulation Lightning—throughout ancient and modern times, those who could survive even one or two were as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns.

dialogue.content: "Do you see now? This is the truth of the Tianji Record." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of desolation. "Every person throughout history who obtained the Tianji Record wished to acquire its complete inheritance, yet all ultimately fell on this path. Some perished to the Eye of Heavenly Dao's erasure, others succumbed to the backlash of the unavoidable death sentence."

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his fists tightly, his knuckles whitening from the strain. He recalled the years of forbearance and scheming, the enemies who fell within his chess games, his sister Chen Nian who remained beyond reach. If he abandoned this path now, how could he ever rescue Chen Nian? If he pressed forward forcefully, could he endure until that day?

At this moment, the Tianji Record's main body suddenly emitted a blinding golden light. A cold, mechanical voice resounded in Chen Ji's mind: "Host attempt to unlock fourth page inheritance core detected. Warning: Using Destiny Scribe abilities will accelerate death countdown. Current remaining lifespan: twenty-three years and seven days. Each ability use will reduce lifespan by three to five years, variable."

choice.prompt: Faced with the cost of the fourth page's inheritance, Chen Ji fell into profound deliberation. This juncture would determine the direction of his future path.

choices.text: Press forward with the inheritance regardless of consequences.
choices.description: Without strength, nothing can be achieved. Acquire the inheritance first, regardless of the cost.
choices.visible_cost: Lifespan significantly reduced, extremely high risk.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the fourth page inheritance core, dramatically enhance strength.
choices.risk_hint: May trigger premature arrival of the unavoidable death sentence.

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, a resolute gleam flickering in his eyes. He retrieved a precious elixir from his embrace—the final trump card left behind by his master, Chen Xuan: the "Heavenly Fate Life-Preserving Pill," which could temporarily suppress the backlash of the unavoidable death sentence. "Since Heaven wishes to oppose me, I shall defy Heaven!" He swallowed the elixir in one gulp, and instantly, golden light blazed around his body.

The fourth page of the Tianji Record slowly unfurled. A brilliant radiance shot into Chen Ji's brow center. Vast information regarding Heavenly Dao's operational principles flooded his Mental Sea like a torrent. However, simultaneously, his features aged perceptibly within moments. This was his lifespan burning away.

choices.description: Gather more intelligence first; act when the time is ripe. Haste makes waste.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, temporarily sealing away the fourth page's information. He rose to his feet, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth: "What's the rush? Those people wish to see me dead—I shall not give them their way. Let them scramble about for a few more days. When I've positioned all the pieces on the chessboard, I'll harvest them all at once."

He emerged from his death-feigning state, stretching his stiffened limbs. His eyes gleamed with cunning light. Xuanwu Sect's genius Han Lie, Inner Disciple Su Qingyao, even the Holy Sect's Ye Qing—these people were unaware they had long been pieces on his chessboard.

choices.description: Since the official conditions are so unfavorable, devise a new path through independent research.
choices.visible_cost: Requires extensive research time, may fail.
choices.visible_reward: Discover an inheritance method with lesser costs.

text.content: A strange smile appeared on Chen Ji's face. "The Eye of Heavenly Dao dictates terms? On what authority?" He began frantically reviewing all notes left by his master, Chen Xuan—perhaps within those seemingly insignificant annotations lay overlooked crucial information.

Suddenly, on a corner of a yellowed page, he discovered an extremely small line of text: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao is not invincible; its weakness lies in..." The subsequent content was obscured by ink stains, but Chen Ji had already glimpsed hope. He murmured to himself: "As expected, this old fox left me a backup plan."

At this very moment, Chen Ji suddenly sensed an unusual fluctuation emanating from deep within the fourth page. It was a scent he knew intimately yet should never have appeared here—gentle, fresh, carrying a faint herbal fragrance. This aura bore an uncanny resemblance to his missing sister, Chen Nian!

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's body stiffened violently. His hands trembled involuntarily. "Little Nian... is that you?" he whispered, his voice carrying an unprecedented tremor. Over these years, he had dreamed of his sister's face countless sleepless nights, imagined countless possibilities of her survival. Now, this familiar scent nearly overwhelmed his emotions.

text.content: However, in the next instant, a chilling malevolence burst forth from the depths of the Tianji Record, completely severing that trace of aura. Then the Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice rang out once more, this time laced with undisguised mockery: "Found her? Unfortunately, that was merely bait I set. Did you truly believe the Tianji Record would let you find her so easily?"

Chen Ji's entire body went rigid. His joints cracked from the force of his clenching. Surging murderous intent roiled within his chest, but his rationality held it in check. He silently recited: "Today's humiliation, I, Chen Ji, shall remember. When I gather the seven Heavenly Fate Fragments, I will make you—the so-called Eye of Heavenly Dao—pay the price!"

The Tianji Record slowly closed. The fourth page's light gradually faded. But before complete silence descended, a line of small text appeared in the corner of the pages—it was Chen Xuan's handwriting: "Within the deepest core of the fourth page lies the key to reversing fate. Beware the Eye of Heavenly Dao's surveillance; its gaze has never left you. Find the forgotten fragment—that is the sole hope."

Chen Ji deeply engraved these words into his mind. "The forgotten fragment"... He suddenly recalled information from his past life. It was the place where a great being from ancient times fell. Perhaps there lay the key Heavenly Fate Fragment. He rose to his feet, gazing toward the distant mountains, a profound smile curling at the corner of his lips.

Beyond the forbidden grounds of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, the first light of dawn pierced through the clouds to illuminate the mortal world. Chen Ji cast one final glance at the cave where he had concealed himself in feigned death for days, a resolute gleam flickering in his eyes. No matter how arduous the path ahead, he would walk it step by step. For revenge, for his sister Chen Nian, and to prove to that高高在上的 Heaven's Eye—he, Chen Ji, was never a piece to be manipulated!
